newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July-Sept cap spending up 8.2 pct yr/yr--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan July-Sept cap spending up 8.2 pct yr/yr--MOF.

text.p: Japanese companies boosted spending on plant and equipment by 8.2 percent in the July-September quarter from the same period last year, a survey by the Ministry of Finance (MOF) showed on Tuesday.
This compared with 7.3 percent year-on-year growth in capital spending in the April-June period.

The quarterly survey of 839,152 companies also showed that corporate current profits increased 12.7 percent in the July-September quarter from a year earlier, compared with year-on-year growth of 34.4 percent in the previous quarter, the ministry said.
"I expect corporate capital spending to continue this steadily rising trend," a MOF official told reporters.
He added that production, income, consumption and corporate capital spending were all showing solid growth.
